messages.en:
{07 00 00}Must I really remind you
about what you promised to
do, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
You foolishly agreed to
deliver the letter to
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}on time. 
{07 15 00}Don't even think about
flaking out on me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas ma pean sulle tõesti
meelde tuletama, mida sa
lubasid, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Sa nõustusid rumalalt
kirja tüübile nimega {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}
õigeks ajaks viima.
{07 15 00}Ära isegi mõtle sellele,
et mind alt vedada,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} remember
that letter you're supposed
to give to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 15 00}You'd better deliver it
before the deadline.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 11 00}or
else, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} mäletad
seda kirja, mille pead
andma tüübile nimega {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 15 00}Parem vii see kohale
enne tähtaega.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 11 00}või
muidu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I know you're a slacker
type that marches to your
own beat, but{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 16 00}You'd better not sit on
that letter too long! Take
it to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
Don't fail me now,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} You're giving
me heartburn, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma tean, et sa oled
looderdaja, kes marsib oma
rütmis, aga{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 16 00}Parem ära istu sellel
kirjal liiga kaua! Vii see
tüübile nimega {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
Ära vea mind nüüd alt,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Sa tekitad mulle
kõrvetisi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
